requirements.title: PRODUCT argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be a numeric array, DIM shall be an integer scalar in range one through rank(ARRAY), and MASK shall be logical and conformable with ARRAY.

pending.PRODUCT-MASK-logical-conformable: Positive source control uses a logical MASK with the same shape as ARRAY; source-control mutations use a numeric mask and a nonconformable logical mask and claim no diagnostic facet.
